title: Fornax Release Candidate Manifest
description: Describes one release candidate across every repo it spans, plus pointers to the Jira tickets that carry QA/Security/Docs/Stage sign-off evidence. Jira is the evidence source of truth; this manifest never duplicates evidence content, only identifies where it lives and which exact candidate it must attest to.

version.description: The candidate release version, e.g. "v0.0.1". Used as the reference token for evidence pointers that are candidate-wide rather than scoped to one repo's SHA.

release_notes_ticket.description: Optional. The Jira issue key (e.g. "FORNX-215") whose description/comments contain the approved release notes/CHANGELOG content for this candidate, per FORNX-235's canonical-release-notes rule. Mutually informative with release_notes_path; at least one should be set before executing a real release, but this is enforced by release-execute.sh's own plan-time check, not this schema.

release_notes_path.description: Optional. Repo-relative path to a committed CHANGELOG/release-notes file (e.g. "CHANGELOG.md") whose content for this version is the approved release notes source, per FORNX-235.

risk_class.description: Optional. This candidate's overall risk/change class per docs/release-assurance-policy.md's Risk/change classes table (FORNX-229) — the highest class among its feature-delta items. Governs assurance depth (FORNX-230/232/233) and which golden-journey tiers coverage reconciliation requires (docs/release-candidate-evidence.md, FORNX-231). release-readiness.sh does not read or enforce this field today; it is validated and consumed by the FORNX-230 orchestration this schema addition unblocks, not retroactively enforced against already-shipped v0.0.1 evidence.

repos.description: Every repo this candidate spans. For a single-repo release this array has one entry.

sha.description: Exact commit SHA of this repo included in the candidate. Full 40-char SHA preferred; 7+ char short SHA accepted.

publishes_artifact.description: True if this repo's build at `sha` produces a versioned artifact that gets tagged/published/promoted as part of this release.

evidence.description: Sign-off pointers. At least one entry per required gate (qa, security, docs, stage) must be present or readiness fails closed.

gate.description: Which required gate this sign-off satisfies.

jira_key.description: The Jira issue key carrying the sign-off, e.g. "FORNX-238".

jira_url.description: Full browse URL for the ticket, for the audit trail in tool output.

applies_to_repos.description: Repo names (matching `repos[].name`) this sign-off attests to the exact SHA of. An empty array means the sign-off is candidate-wide and must instead reference the manifest `version` string, not a per-repo SHA.
